summary: Master Product Discovery and Customer-Centric Design to define outcomes, map opportunities, and validate solutions. Enroll in our 5-day intermediate course toda
lede: Product Discovery and Customer-Centric Design helps teams replace guesswork with a structured approach to understanding customer needs before committing to development. You will learn to define outcomes, conduct continuous interviews, map opportunities, generate solution options, and test assumptions to reduce hidden risks. Through practical exercises, you will turn research into prioritized opportunities and validated roadmaps. You will practice writing interview questions, creating opportunity maps, running assumption tests, and applying impact-based prioritization while balancing customer insight, delivery constraints, and stakeholder needs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for intermediate-level professionals who need to gather customer insights, define product outcomes, and validate solutions before development.
modules: Defining Clear Outcomes for Product Discovery
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Working knowledge of agile product development cycles and basic familiarity with user experience (UX) principles. No coding or programming skills are required. Participants should bring a laptop for hands-on exercises and be prepared to engage in real-world case study simulations.
